metadata.description: Full address of the private 1-to-1 site, e.g. https://<tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<site> (no trailing slash).
The Team Leader's email address. Receives submissions and problem reports.

Initialize_varTestDate.description: Leave empty in production. For a test run, e.g. 2026-11-20T07:00:00

Check_setup_has_run.expression: @or(equals(outputs('Ids')?['owners'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['fullControl'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['edit'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['read'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['reviewsList'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['mgrList'], null))

STOP_run_the_setup_flow_first.inputs: @int('The 1-to-1 permission levels or Owners group were not found. Run ESG 1-to-1 | 0 Setup first.')

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hi @{first(split(outputs('Mgr')?['Technician']?['DisplayName'], ' '))},

Your monthly 1-to-1 is ready: Open my 1-to-1

Deadline: @{outputs('DeadlineText')}.

You can save and come back as often as you like before you submit.

inputs.value: @concat('FAILED for ', items('Each_technician')?['Title'], ' – no email was sent. Open the run history for details.')

parameters.emailMessage/Body: Your 1-to-1 hasn't been submitted yet. Anything you've saved is still there: Continue

Wb_days.inputs: @if(empty(if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], ''))), 999999, div(sub(ticks(concat(if(empty(if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], ''))), outputs('Today'), if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], ''))), 'T00:00:00Z')), ticks(concat(outputs('Today'), 'T00:00:00Z'))), 864000000000))

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Wellbeing assessment @{if(equals(outputs('Wb_days'), 7), 'due in 7 days', if(equals(outputs('Wb_days'), 0), 'due today', 'overdue'))}: @{items('Each_date_check')?['Title']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The next wellbeing assessment for @{items('Each_date_check')?['Title']} @{if(equals(outputs('Wb_days'), 7), 'is due in 7 days', if(equals(outputs('Wb_days'), 0), 'is due today', concat('was due ', string(sub(0, outputs('Wb_days'))), ' days ago')))} (@{formatDateTime(if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['NextWellbeingDate'], '')), 'dd-MMM-yyyy')}). Arrange the conversation and start the assessment from the Wellbeing tab, or change the date in ⚙ Settings → Team.

Open the 1-to-1 page

Ap_days.inputs: @if(empty(if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], ''))), 999999, div(sub(ticks(concat(if(empty(if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], ''))), outputs('Today'), if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], ''))), 'T00:00:00Z')), ticks(concat(outputs('Today'), 'T00:00:00Z'))), 864000000000))

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The appraisal for @{items('Each_date_check')?['Title']} @{if(equals(outputs('Ap_days'), 7), 'is due in 7 days', if(equals(outputs('Ap_days'), 0), 'is due today', concat('was due ', string(sub(0, outputs('Ap_days'))), ' days ago')))} (@{formatDateTime(if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_date_check')?['AppraisalDate'], '')), 'dd-MMM-yyyy')}). When it's done, use ⚙ Settings → Team → Mark appraisal completed; to move it, change the date there.
